title: Events alert — 2026-11-19
body:
**Today: Anthropic (ANT) begins Nasdaq trading.** The IPO priced at $83/share, raising ~$81.3B — the largest listing on record — at roughly $1.5T fully diluted; first trade at the open, 9:30 ET / 15:30 Berlin. Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC are anchored in a parallel $26B private placement. **Chain read:** a strong debut supports semis (NVDA/AVGO/TSM/MU cross-holdings and AI demand narrative) and infrastructure names; a break below $83 hits AI sentiment complex-wide. Power/utilities unaffected near-term; keep the cash sleeve.

**Just landed:** Nvidia's Nov 17 beat-and-raise (FQ3 revenue $115.8B, ~2x YoY; GM guide 71–72% vs 74.8%) was sold — -2.9% on Nov 18. Oct FOMC minutes were hawkish (Waller floated a 50bp Dec hike; 10Y 5.07%).

*No other chain earnings or macro releases due in the next 2 days; next: NFP Dec 4, FOMC Dec 8–9.*
